I'll tell you. Suppose we have a USDJPY demand zone 30 pips wide. Now, you set limit buy order for every pip in that zone. So, that gives you 30 buy limit orders. Next, you choose a currency that has a high correlation coefficient with the USDJPY - GBPJPY for example. Demand zone for GBPJPY zone is 35 pips wide. You use the same procedure of placing buy limit orders as in the USDJPY. That gives you 35 buy limit orders. Market begins to move, demand level has been hit and penetrated 90% on both pairs. So you end up with 27 buy orders on USDJPY, and 32 orders on GBPJPY. Demand levels holds and the market begins to move in your direction. Finaly, USDJPY is 80 pips up and GBPJPY 120 pips up. And voilà... you made 80x27+120*32= 2.160+3.840 = 5.960 pips in one day.
